place.source_title: Small glazed kiosk box on the rebuilt pier walkway (Navy Pier, 2022)

brief: A pier kiosk: a small glazed kiosk box on the rebuilt pier walkway (Navy Pier, 2022); a tiny booth with a serving hatch. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a 2016-22 ticket kiosk on the rebuilt Navy Pier south dock: a dark metal box with a cantilevered flat roof plate and a glazed counter, on a herringbone brick promenade by moored cruise boats; tall glass-and-steel pier buildings beside

why.note: pier kiosks: the smallest rentable unit, a booth per boat line or vendor, placed along the promenade flow
the 2016 pier rebuild replaced festival kiosks with sober dark boxes
